ops.title: vcstest: linkInterpreters collides when two tools' interpreters share a basename
ops.description:
`internal/vcstest/shim.go`'s `linkInterpreters` dedupes by full interpreter PATH
but symlinks by `filepath.Base`, so two tools whose shebangs name different
`node` binaries collide on `os.Symlink` -> EEXIST -> an opaque `t.Fatal`.

Unreachable today: git and jj carry no shebang, and gt is the only script tool in
the fixture set. Accumulating tools across fixtures (landed 2026-08-02) makes it
marginally more reachable by putting more tools in one bin dir.

Found during the vcstest double-fixture hardening and deliberately left out of
scope there.

ops.text: A collision fails with a message naming both interpreter paths and the two tools that wanted them, instead of surfacing raw EEXIST from os.Symlink
A regression test constructs the collision with two fake script tools whose shebangs name same-basename interpreters in different directories
